question:
**In the following questions a statement has been given with highlighted text. Select the options that can replace the text correct idiom or phrase.**

The trainee performed the task with extreme ease.
solution:
The correct answer is: A piece of cake

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The idiom "A piece of cake" means something that is very easy to do. (कुछ ऐसा जो करना बहुत आसान है)

 
 
• Example - *The boy found the project to be a piece of cake because it was incredibly easy.*
 
 
 
• So, it is clear that the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom "A piece of cake" is "**to perform the task with extreme ease**"

Hence, the correct answer is option 4.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• At the eleventh hour: Refers to doing something at the last possible moment or just before it is too late.
 
• Call it a day: This phrase means to stop working on something or to end an activity for the day.
 
• Swan song: Refers to a final act or performance before retirement or the end of a career, often implying that it's the best or most memorable.
